title: Answer: scale, disruption and compressibility tests

statements.text: Field boundaries found at no consistent spatial scale would count against the boundary account. For valence, pleasant states that are not more compressible or consonant would count against it, though the 2020 overview says one failed proxy would not invalidate the theory.

sources.quote: We predict that such exercises will only identify topologies at a broadly consistent spatial scale
If it's not, it doesn't invalidate it.
